scope: Test exports compared byte for byte; report timings/log timestamps are intentionally excluded

denominators.structural_validity_percent: all candidate items in successfully decoded v1.0 envelopes
denominators.semantic_acceptance_percent: structurally valid candidate items, before deduplication
denominators.operation_generation_coverage_percent: all parsed OpenAPI operations, including unsupported ones
denominators.category_distribution: validated unique exported tests (counts, not percentages)

metrics.accounting: proposed_tests = validated_tests + rejected_tests + duplicates; failed envelopes contribute no candidate items
metrics.coverage_scope: generation coverage of declared operations; no API execution, behavior or code coverage
